entity.summary: Malaysian centralized digital-asset exchange offering MYR markets, order-book trading, wallet transfers, and institutional services under the KDX brand.
entity.notes: Kinetic DAX Sdn. Bhd. is the continuing Malaysian operator formerly known as Tokenize Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd. The current KDX site provides MYR order-book exchange and wallet services and identifies the company as a Securities Commission Malaysia-registered Digital Asset Exchange. The SC's current DAX list, updated 2026-07-20, lists Kinetic DAX Sdn Bhd. BX50 records the current KDX identity as one continuing entity and does not infer identity with separate non-Malaysian Tokenize operators.

evidence.title: KDX Malaysian digital asset exchange
evidence.notes: Current first-party site presents MYR spot markets, a full order book, wallet functions, and the operator identity Kinetic DAX Sdn. Bhd., formerly Tokenize Technology (M) Sdn. Bhd.

evidence.title: List of Registered Digital Asset Exchanges
evidence.notes: The current SC list identifies Kinetic DAX Sdn Bhd as a registered Malaysian Recognized Market Operator-Digital Asset Exchange.
